articles.title: Two more victims of corrupt police officer have convictions quashed
Man charged after June Kenwood shooting that seriously injured a 15-year-old boy
articles.description:
A 48-year-old Chicago man has been charged with attempted murder after shooting at three people, including a 15-year-old boy who was seriously wounded in June in the Kenwood neighborhood.

Shauntay Sardin, 48, was charged with three counts of attempted murder because there were two additional victims who were not shot, and aggravated battery, police said.

On June 20 in the 700 block of East 47th Street, Sardin allegedly opened fire at three people, including a 15-year-old boy who was shot and seriously injured, police said.

Sardin, of the 1900 block of East 72nd Place in South Shore and who was arrested Monday in the 5100 block of South Indiana Avenue, was due for a detention hearing Tuesday at the Leighton Criminal Courthouse

articles.title: UN report finds Nicaraguan government responsible for in-custody deaths
articles.description: A U.N. report says the Nicaraguan government is responsible for at least eight deaths in custody since 2018. The report published Tuesday condemns the government of co-Presidents Daniel Ortega and Rosario Murillo for crushing dissent and canceling elections. It highlights inconsistencies in the death of Indigenous leader Brooklyn Rivera, who died in May after 32 months in prison. The official explanation linked his death to COVID-19 complications, but an independent assessment found this "not medically coherent." The report calls for Rivera’s body to be released for a traditional burial and urges the government to release information on missing detainees.

articles.title: Chicago police fatally shoot dog that attacked them in Humboldt Park
articles.description:
Chicago police shot and killed a dog that attacked them while the officers were working on an investigation in the Humboldt Park neighborhood Monday, police said.

Shortly before 5 p.m., the officers were in the 700 block of North Christiana Avenue when a dog approached and attacked an officer. One of the officers then shot the dog.

The dog died and the city's Department of Animal Care and Control was notified.

Three officers were taken to nearby hospitals in good condition. No other injuries were reported.

Detectives are continuing to investigate the incident.
